definition: Independent alternative communications paths, nodes or providers that maintain connectivity when a primary element fails. Includes route diversity, backup links, redundant nodes and provider diversity with an explicit continuity function, and laws, regulations, standards and plans specifically about network redundancy. Additional capacity or coverage alone is insufficient. Data or application recovery is disaster_recovery; backup electricity is backup_power; protective engineering is resilient_infrastructure_design. Links to recovery sites qualify only when an independent alternative communications path is explicit. Excludes redundancy of roads and other nondigital transport infrastructure.
boundary: Not data or application recovery, which is disaster_recovery; not backup electricity, which is backup_power; not protective engineering, which is resilient_infrastructure_design; not extra capacity or coverage alone.
